	<div class="entry-content-wrap">

<div class="entry-content single-content">
	<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_5cd4a1-b4 alignfull wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kb-blocks-bg-video-container embedded"><div class="kb-bg-video-iframe kb-bg-video-ratio-16-9"><iframe frameborder="0" class="kb-blocks-bg-video youtube" id="bg-row-video-27_5cd4a1-b4" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/PLZCKBxhkuM?autoplay=1&amp;controls=0&amp;mute=1&amp;muted=1&amp;loop=1&amp;playlist=PLZCKBxhkuM&amp;disablekb=1&amp;modestbranding=1&amp;playsinline=1&amp;rel=0&amp;background=1" autoplay></iframe></div></div><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_3d9fc1-c2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"></div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_b7ff4a-30 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_3f55fc-f8 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading27_e26d8f-f9 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading27_e26d8f-f9">Studios Vrettos Beachfront Hotel in Naxos</h2>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Experience the true essence of Greek hospitality at our beachfront hotel, managed by a local Greek family with over 25 years of expertise in exceptional service. Just a minute away from the beautiful Plaka Beach, our hotel offers the luxury of peace, warmth, and tranquility, making it your ideal retreat on this captivating island.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Explore the archaeological sites, visit traditional settlements, relish unique flavors with the finest fresh and highest quality ingredients, enjoy local products, explore the traditional mountain villages and discover small secret beaches, jump from the cliffs, learn watersports like kitesurfing, windsurfing, wing foiling, paddle surf, sail among this beautiful cluster of islands and swim and snorkel in transparent waters.</p>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-27_74fee1-32"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_086e4e-7f alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_555775-6a inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image27_0c2f75-e6 size-large kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-land43"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="678" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/DSC_0008-2-1-1024x678.jpg" alt="dsc 0008 (2)" class="kb-img wp-image-191" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/DSC_0008-2-1-1024x678.jpg 1024w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/DSC_0008-2-1-300x199.jpg 300w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/DSC_0008-2-1-768x509.jpg 768w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/DSC_0008-2-1.jpg 1400w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_6643e2-32 inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_58b376-57 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_24ad5f-b3 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Your Beachfront Hotel in Naxos</h2>

<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Studios &amp; Apartments</h5>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Relax in our spacious and modern rooms, each meticulously renovated with handmade furniture and designed in the charming Cycladic style to provide the utmost comfort. Wake up to breathtaking views of the sea or our garden, adorned with olive and palm trees. </p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Enjoy the convenience of our private path leading directly to the beach, ensuring easy access to the sun, turquoise water and white sand. Cool off in a hammock in our garden in the shade of an olive tree. Read a book, practice yoga, and engage in activities that you don’t usually have time for in your daily routine. </p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Escape the crowds and traffic jams of the city center, Naxos town (called Chora); in our neighborhood (Plaka), you will find a quieter and more peaceful environment.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_a770cf-2a alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_f6d4ae-24 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_4546f7-b3 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_5d0065-e6 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Our &#8221;Private Beach&#8221; in Plaka</h2>

<p class="has-text-align-center">This beach area is known for having the best beaches of the Island and heading south from here, you can witness the most stunning watercolors.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Imagine a pristine beach, where the sand is as soft as powdered sugar, stretching out endlessly beneath the golden sun. The water gently touches the shore, its color reminiscent of the purest turquoise gemstones. The water is so clear that you can see the bottom of the sea. The combination of the sun, the mesmerizing, translucent turquoise waters and the color of the sand creates a scene straight from a tropical dream, inviting you to immerse yourself in the beauty of this coastal paradise.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">While Plaka Beach is a public gem, our hotel’s location makes it feel like a private spot. Enjoy the sun and sea without the crowds, creating an intimate atmosphere for couples, families, and solo travelers alike.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Indulge yourself in this tranquil retreat of this enchanting island. The beach embodies an idyllic paradise where time seems to stand still, and worries fade away.</p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_d3a797-dd inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image27_3df438-df size-large kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-land43"><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="879" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image00019-2-1024x879.jpg" alt="image00019 (2)" class="kb-img wp-image-231" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image00019-2-1024x879.jpg 1024w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image00019-2-300x258.jpg 300w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image00019-2-768x659.jpg 768w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/image00019-2.jpg 1400w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_8c36c1-b9 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_c6fe24-69 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image27_066883-6a size-large kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-land43"><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="683" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2-1024x683.jpg" alt="insta4 (2)" class="kb-img wp-image-73" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2-1024x683.jpg 1024w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2-300x200.jpg 300w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2-768x512.jpg 768w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2-1536x1024.jpg 1536w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/insta4-2.jpg 2048w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_f60617-db inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_2397c7-0e alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_c05851-44 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Rooftop Bar Naxos</h2>

<h5 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">&#8220;The meeting point&#8221;</h5>

<p class="has-text-align-center">In the top of the Hotel, you will find our Rooftop bar Naxos, which welcomes you during the night. It opens for sunset and it closes at 11 pm to leave our guests rest in silence.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Is there anything more mesmerizing than watching a glowing sun descend into the horizon, the sky ablaze with brilliant oranges, yellows and reds in its wake?</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Every element of the cocktails has been carefully thought for you, from the design to the approach to service and drinks making.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">You could taste a variety of Mediterranean dishes, prepared with fresh and local products, combined with our signatures cocktails that you can enjoy under the incredible view of the stars setting the end of an amazing day.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center"></p>

<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-16018d1d wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">

</div>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_c794d4-51 alignnone kt-row-has-bg wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-layout-top-sep kt-row-sep-type-waves"><svg viewBox="0 0 1000 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg></div><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_5b0046-e2 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_977bdb-b2 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_259c60-bf inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading27_657f44-f4 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading27_657f44-f4">Ride the journey with us!</h2>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-27_1b6f3a-fe"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id27_a87ebf-4b aligncenter wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-3-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top kb-theme-content-width">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_261fd6-aa inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading27_4ec2d3-3f wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading27_4ec2d3-3f">NAME YOUR DATES</h4>

<p class="has-text-align-left has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-d1d4101b2ddd650a78f6d0eca12464ec">Leave behind the pressure of everyday life, an enviable destination awaits you. Get away from the city, lay down in virgin beaches, enjoying the tranquility of the island. Our experience allows us to offer you a journey tailored made to your preference. You may come whenever you would like, stay as long as you wish and personalize every detail.</p>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_934426-5f inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading27_ef9f68-c1 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading27_ef9f68-c1">CHOOSE YOUR ACCOMMODATION</h4>

<p class="has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-05daedd36350453481683509dc27e76d">Stay in our Beachfront Hotel, a healing hideaway in Plaka Beach. A variety of accommodation choices are available, double or triple studios with cooking facilities or apartments for 4/5 people equipped with a kitchen as well. All the rooms include breakfast with local and fresh products. The rooms are tailored for families, group of friends, couples or solo travelers.</p>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column27_fdf97a-d8 inner-column-3"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h4 class="kt-adv-heading27_8ed843-36 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading27_8ed843-36">LET YOUR STORY BEGIN</h4>

<p class="has-theme-palette-9-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-4efcb69033e4dadfc00dc11ea966412b">Now, you are invited to discover a holistic experience that stays true to the beauty of the Cyclades Islands. Get ready for your Naxos getaway at our Beachfront Hotel, it is better experienced than explained. Regardless of whether you are travelling as a couple, with family, or as a solo adventurer, this incredible island promises enjoyment for everyone. Buy a ticket to paradise, and let the beauty of Plaka Beach kick-start your amazing journey!</p>
</div></div>
